newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian granny in wheelchair caught with heroin.
newsitem.headline: Colombian granny in wheelchair caught with heroin.

text.p: A wheelchair-bound Colombian grandmother was stopped in her tracks on charges of trying to smuggle heroin aboard a flight for Miami, Bogota's El Tiempo newspaper reported on Wednesday.

It said 63-year-old Sol Maria Camargo Cabrera, a U.S. resident, was arrested and charged Tuesday in the Caribbean port of Barranquilla, her hometown, after 1.5 pounds (685 grams) of high-grade heroin were discovered strapped to her body and hidden inside disposable incontinence pads.
The newspaper quoted Gen. Paulino Marca Daza, a regional police commander, as saying the case was "regrettable" because "the lady took advantage of her physical state to try to fool the authorities."
